name: telegram-chat
description: Two-way Telegram bot channel: pipeline notifications + chat commands (/status, /pause, /approve…) + freeform chat with inline buttons and reactions (opt-in)

configSchema.label: Bot token
configSchema.help: From @BotFather (/newbot). Paste the token, or reference an env var with {"$env":"TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN"}.

configSchema.label: Notify chat IDs
configSchema.help: Comma-separated chat IDs that receive run notifications. Message the bot, then run Doctor / check getUpdates for chat.id (negative IDs are groups).

configSchema.label: Allowed chat IDs (commands)
configSchema.help: Comma-separated chat IDs allowed to send commands (/status, /pause, /approve…). EMPTY = nobody: anyone in an allowed chat can control worca-cc. Replies from a notified chat that is not listed get a one-line hint naming its ID.

configSchema.label: Allowed user IDs (optional)
configSchema.help: Comma-separated numeric Telegram user IDs (message.from.id in getUpdates). When set, only these people may send commands, even in an allowed chat; others are ignored. EMPTY = everyone in an allowed chat. In a group chat, /direct and the answer commands are only accepted from these people.

configSchema.label: /direct and answers in group chats
configSchema.help: /direct, /answer, /approve, /retry, /abort and /cancel steer a live run. listed users (default): in a group chat, only Allowed user IDs may use them (nobody when that is empty); direct messages to the bot always work. anyone: every member of an allowed group chat may.

configSchema.label: Freeform chat
configSchema.help: on: a listed member chats with worca's Ask engine (paid model turns). In a direct message to the bot every message continues one conversation; in an allowed group, mentioning the bot opens one (a forum topic, or a reply thread under the bot's header). The chat must be in Allowed chat IDs; a direct message's chat ID is the person's user ID. Needs Freeform chat members. off (default): commands and notifications only.

configSchema.label: Freeform chat members
configSchema.help: Comma- or newline-separated telegramUserId=worca identity pairs, e.g. 123456789=ada@example.com. Only these people may start or continue a freeform chat or press its buttons. The identity is who worca records for their chats and runs (use their worca sign-in on a shared deployment, or local).

configSchema.label: Worca address for links (optional)
configSchema.help: Base address for Open in worca buttons, e.g. https://worca.example.com. Telegram refuses buttons to addresses it cannot open (such as localhost); those messages then go out without the button. Empty: messages name the chat instead of linking.
